sentences.text: 14.08.2024 Heard Mr. Z Kamar, learned senior counsel for the petitioner, assisted by Mr. D Talukdar, Advocate as well as Mr. P P Borthakur, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam.
The Case Diary be called for.
I have heard the learned counsel for both the sides on the prayer of interim protection.

Mr.
Borthakur has raised objection against the prayer of interim relief.
Having heard the learned counsel for both the sides, this court is of the opinion that the petitioners deserve to be given interim protection.

sentences.text:
Page No.# 2/2 Accordingly, in the interim, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the petitioner,
namely, Apurba Kumar Medhi, in connection with Morigaon P.S. Case No. 190/2024 registered under sections 120B/409/419/420/465/468/471 IPC the arresting authority shall release him on bail of Rs.20,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.

It is directed that the petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer within next 10 (ten)
days.
